method.evaluation: A useful interval covers at least half the true edit and reaches 0.30 temporal IoU. Report correct and misplaced refinements, losses, genuine and same-word refinements, and same-clock matches. The methods localize existing alerts so they cannot recover missed alerts or add a new file flag.
method.geometry: Use the exact two-second crop that raised the original alert. Examine three contained one-second windows on the half-second grid with the normal one-second speech admission.
method.perturbation: Before inference, taper the upper 40 normalized Mel bands inside one candidate to zero, or to the median of the nearest 12 feature positions on each available side. Use a five-frame linear taper. Retain all other features and every attention position. Measure the original context logit minus the perturbed logit. Keep the lower drop, with a separate agreement route requiring the same unique winner for both fills. The density comparator uses the median unperturbed local frame response.
method.points: Freeze a strict and wider cut separately for each readout using existing broad flags in the stock development panel. Use the highest and second-highest genuine source group maxima, respectively; keep a zero floor for the two finite-drop readouts. When fewer than two groups support a same-winner point, reuse the two-fill points. Retain the broad window below or on the point, or when no candidate qualifies.
